en.quote: Mandatory conscription into military service will be abolished in Russia in 2010.
en.head: Conscription was not abolished: in 2023 Putin signed a law setting the draft age at 18 to 30
en.body: The law raised the upper conscription age from 27 to 30 and took effect on January 1, 2024. A transition to an all-contract force had been promised again: on October 24, 2017, Putin said, “We should keep in mind that we are gradually moving away from conscript service altogether” (Lenta.ru).
